Interface IHasAppearDelay

Namespace: osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A tooltip which provides a custom delay until it appears, override the osu.Framework.Graphics.Cursor.TooltipContainer-wide default.

public interface IHasAppearDelay : ITooltipContentProvider, IDrawable, ITransformable
